summary_en: This study tests obecabtagene autoleucel (obe-cel) as consolidation treatment in adults with B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) that is in first complete remission without measurable residual disease. It is given as an infusion about 3 days (plus or minus 1 day) after lymphodepleting chemotherapy, and the number of doses and total treatment length are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; this is a Phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa obecabtagene autoleucel (obe-cel) como tratamiento de consolidación en adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda (LLA) de células B que está en primera remisión completa sin enfermedad residual medible. Se administra como infusión aproximadamente 3 días (más o menos 1 día) después de la quimioterapia linfodepletiva, y el número de dosis y la duración total del tratamiento no se indican. La medida principal de resultado no se indica; este es un estudio de Fase II.
who_for: Adults aged 40 or older; ages 30-39 allowed with high-risk comorbidities or poor chemotherapy tolerability
In MRD-negative complete remission or complete remission with incomplete hematologic recovery at screening
Adequate liver, kidney, oxygen and heart function, and ECOG performance status 0-2
Philadelphia chromosome-negative or positive disease (Ph-positive is an exploratory cohort)
not_for: Measurable extramedullary (outside the bone marrow) disease at screening
Recent high-dose corticosteroids or certain other recent cancer medicines, within stated time limits
Uncontrolled active infection at leukapheresis or CAR T cell infusion
Positive tests for HIV, hepatitis B or C, HTLV, or syphilis
